gaps.explanation: Re-read pp7-8 (governmental funds statement), pp15-19 (budget-basis schedules of the five major funds) and pp20-21 (nonmajor combining statement). Every fund is in detail[] exactly once: General, Keno, Streets, LB 840 and Downtown Development from their own Budget and Actual (Budget Basis) schedules; the nine nonmajor funds from the combining statement (no fund column without lines, no subtotal/total rows, no budget column read as actual, no fund present from two sources). Statement (p7-8 columns) vs schedule (Actual Amounts column) total revenues per fund: General 3,545,538 vs 5,898,049 (+2,352,511); Keno 1,737,143 vs 1,768,475 (+31,332); Street 1,661,224 vs 2,094,444 (+433,220); LB 840 352,611 vs 623,753 (+271,142); Downtown Development 325,733 vs 539,306 (+213,573); Nonmajor 2,265,637 vs 2,265,637 (0). Sum 3,301,778 = schedule above statement. Cause: the budget-basis schedules have no other-financing section; their 'Local' revenue line carries the money the GAAP statement prints under OTHER FINANCE SOURCES (General Operating transfers in 2,600,643; Downtown Operating transfers in 252,386; LB 840 Payments received from loan 255,293), and the budget basis differs otherwise (e.g. no fair-value interest losses; budget-basis fund balances differ: General Oct 1 3,890,334 on p15 vs 3,756,654 on p7). The budget schedules' fund-balance roll-forwards (p15 (1,240,794) + 3,890,334 = 2,649,540) are complete without any transfer row, so the transfers are inside the printed lines. The pages print no budget-to-GAAP reconciliation, so the per-fund difference cannot be itemized further. Nothing counted twice, nothing missing. Statement side checked: JSON receipts = p8 Total column 2,480,815 + 2,060,320 + 2,837,396 + 2,380,214 - 78,812 + 207,953 = 9,887,886 (printed). No fix.

Total expenditures statement (p7-8) vs budget schedule actual: General 4,894,254 vs 7,138,843 (+2,244,589); Keno 1,773,371 vs 1,773,370 (-1); Street 1,853,772 vs 1,850,013 (-3,759); LB 840 476,696 vs 476,697 (+1); Downtown Development 1,287,075 vs 1,422,700 (+135,625); Nonmajor 1,344,446 vs 1,344,446 (0, pp20-21 combining). Sum 2,376,455 = schedule above statement. The budget-basis expenditures include the operating transfers out that the GAAP statement prints under other financing: Downtown 1,287,075 + 135,625 = 1,422,700 exactly; General 4,894,254 + 2,244,924 = 7,139,178 vs 7,138,843 (335 other budget-basis difference). The printed budget lines are not duplicates and are kept; the GAAP transfer cells are not added (their money is inside these lines). No fix.

Statement p8 Operating transfers in: General 2,600,643 + Downtown Development 252,386 + Nonmajor 213,181 + Eliminations (886,210) = Total 2,180,000. Detail transfers in 213,181 = Capital Sinking Fund 44,924 + Tourism Fund 168,257 (p20-21 combining; ties to the Nonmajor column). The General and Downtown transfers in are not printed on their budget-basis schedules (pp15, 19) as rows; that money is inside the schedules' 'Local' revenue lines (General Local 3,140,466; Downtown Local 256,973; see revenue entry), so adding the p7-8 transfer cells would count it twice. Gap 2,600,643 + 252,386 - 886,210 (Eliminations column, never used for detail) = 1,966,819. No fix.

Statement p8 Operating transfers out: General (2,244,924) + Downtown Development (135,625) + Nonmajor (841,289) + Eliminations 886,210 = Total (2,335,628). Detail transfers out 841,289 = Sales Tax Fund (p20 combining; ties to the Nonmajor column). The General and Downtown transfers out are inside their budget-basis expenditure lines (p19 Downtown Development 1,422,700 = GAAP 1,287,075 + 135,625 exactly; p15 General 7,138,843 = GAAP 4,894,254 + 2,244,924 - 335), so adding them would count the money twice. Gap 2,244,924 + 135,625 - 886,210 = 1,494,339. No fix.
